thread:
sarah: starting layerwise KV quant run — goal: compare FP8-kv, INT8-kv, and hybrid (top layers FP8, rest INT8) on a prefix-heavy chat workload. config: batch=1 seq=2048 kv_mode=layerwise running on r4 (A100). will collect p50/p95, mem delta, and QoR on small eval set.

benchbot: queued shadow job qb-7821. ETA ~12m. baseline (fp16-kv) for reference: p50=23ms, p95=120ms, mem=48GB.

chen: note — eviction_threshold=1MB per shard for this run, might bias results toward FP8. can we try eviction=2MB after first pass?

sarah: yep launching eviction=2MB variant after first shadow. also including eval200 prompt set for quick quality checks.

benchbot: first shadow complete. summary:
- FP8-kv: p50=25ms (+8% vs baseline), p95=170ms (+42%), mem=36GB (-25%)
- INT8-kv: p50=24ms (+4%), p95=135ms (+12%), mem=40GB (-16%)
- Hybrid (top4 FP8): p50=24ms (+4%), p95=140ms (+17%), mem=38GB (-21%)
- QoR deltas (FP8 vs baseline on eval200): ROUGE-L -0.7 pts, ExactMatch -0.3 pts
Notes: FP8 p95 spikes line up with bursts of cache-evictions.

marta: rough numbers look good for memory, but FP8 p95 spike is worrying. do we have traces linking evictions to cold KV hits?

benchbot: attaching flame graph + eviction log: https://internal.redwood/bench/qb-7821/logs
(evictions align with tokens ~512-768 in several long prompts)

sarah: started eviction=2MB + kv-prefetch=true run. will compare results and post diffs.

james: Quick thought — FP8 dequant penalty might be from temp casts during de-serialization. try toggling dequant-in-place=true to avoid extra copies.

benchbot: eviction=2MB + prefetch run done:
- FP8-kv: p50=24ms, p95=130ms, mem=37GB
- Hybrid (top4 FP8): p50=23.5ms, p95=125ms, mem=38GB
- QoR diffs: FP8 ROUGE-L -0.5 pts vs baseline, EM similar
Notes: dequant-in-place reduced p95 by ~10ms on avg; eviction=2MB cut the worst-case spikes significantly.

anya: can we get a per-layer fidelity heatmap? especially layers 0-3 and last 2 layers — want to see where FP8 introduces most error.

sarah: good idea. queuing per-layer fidelity run (KL divergence + MSE on KV tensors).

benchbot: per-layer job qb-7827 queued. ETA ~8m.

benchbot: per-layer fidelity results ready:
- Layers 0-3: MSE ~0.02, KL <0.01
- Middle layers 4-7: MSE ~0.06, KL ~0.03
- Top layers 8-11: MSE ~0.12, KL ~0.08
Suggestion: keep top2 layers FP16/FP32 or at least FP8->FP16, keep rest INT8 for best latency/mem tradeoff.

marta: action items:
- sarah: draft rollout runbook for hybrid per-layer (top2 FP16, rest INT8)
- ops: stage canary with kv-prefetch and dequant-in-place on 10% traffic
- eng-ml: follow-up perf + QoR check after 24h canary

sarah: ack — I'll draft the runbook and canary config today and ping infra for staging. thanks all :thumbsup:
